title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
reflectionQuestion: What helps you feel safe and calm when it is time to sleep?
kidSafetyNotes: First comfort-ritual: gentle frame (own words: 'God watches over us like a shepherd') around the verbatim WEB Psalm 23. WEB keeps 'Yahweh is my shepherd'; the frame carries the familiar warmth so a 4-7 meets the comfort first. Full psalm kept (incl. 'valley of the shadow of death' / 'enemies') — v4 is the comforting turn. Verse numbers stripped for narration; wording is verbatim WEB. Exempt from the short word floor (comfort-ritual).
createdNote: Comfort pillar; first comfort-ritual build (template for Lord's Prayer / Beatitudes). Voice VOICE_ARABELLA (lane's first female narrator). Mood weary (fills an empty mood).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
